attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to permit and log TCP/23 traffic from node3 to node4, and node2 (OPNsense) to reject and log that same traffic, using a forced routing path (node3 → node1 → node2; the four nodes actually share one flat /24, so node2 would otherwise route straight to node4). A live connection attempt from node3 produced one correlated log-entry pair — same IP ID, source port, and destination port — showing accept-and-log at node1 immediately followed by block/reject-and-log at node2, proving traffic was permitted through node1 and stopped at node2. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol; boot-identity changes were confirmed on every node, and the routing/firewall configuration and the pass/refuse behavior were verified to persist and reproduce identically after all four reboots.
